verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime with a chat app, so an AI-insights-on-your-data feature is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows only general model chat, APIs and SDKs. These are building blocks a user could use to analyze their own data, not a documented in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
